notes.title: Ghoulish Gardens
notes.content:
[b]Happy Halloween everyone! [/b]
To Celebrate the spooky season a new track is available to be unlocked.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40434030/5ae5e2687c87c871751a7d7f6533dfdff406a143.png[/img]
[b][u]Ghoulish Gardens[/u][/b]
Race around a haunted courtyard dodging gravestones through a thick fog in Ghoulish Gardens. To Unlock this track first reach chapter 4 in story mode. In each mission there is a hidden pumpkin to find. Collect the Pumpkin in 4-1, then 4-2 and so on to unlock Ghoulish Gardens in Arcade, Survival and multiplayer modes!
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40434030/e1840cd1fe45be4621aa9fd2df1bdd8e4a4b9b05.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40434030/060cd59e63d262854bd7c4a36bc5b8c41f00f343.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40434030/35b932f3964271a32d3e3edbc5bd47f6538f4c1e.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40434030/893e6be0c26ac9268526bf634c2f4bd370a08168.jpg[/img][/url]
The 2 previous timed event tracks (Incredible Icecap & Cloudy Cruise) can now once again be Unlocked, this time permanently! Not sure how to unlock them? Check out their Update announcements for more information! 

Here's a list of everything that has changed with this update:
[list]
[*]Ghoulish Gardens Added
[*]Incredible Icecap returns
[*]Cloudy Cruise returns 
[*]Fixed issue with Cloudy Cruise achievement
[/list]

notes.title: Version 2.2.1
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed Issue where selecting Cloudy Cruise on the 95 Mode track select would display the wrong preview image. 
[*]Added a new trailer to the store page. 
[/list]

notes.title: Cloudy Cruise & HD Resolution Options
notes.content:
A new event is coming to World Racing '95, and up for grabs is a new 95 Mode course "Cloudy Cruise", where one wrong move can send you plummeting off course with no way back. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40434030/35b932f3964271a32d3e3edbc5bd47f6538f4c1e.jpg[/img]

To unlock this new track you must 
[olist]
[*] Unlock 95 mode (Complete Chapter 1 of Story Mode)
[*] Select Cloudy Cruise from the 95 Mode track select.
[*] Complete the ring challenge and finish the race. 
[/olist] 
One you've completed those steps the course is yours to keep. This event ends May 31st so get your head out the clouds and snag it while you can. 

Unfortunately this does mean the Incredible Icecap event has come to an end, if you had already unlocked the track it will still be there for you to play. For those who missed out it's not gone forever and will be back once the Winter season rolls around again.

In addition to the new event, this update also include a new graphics toggle feature. Due to popular demand, players can now choose between big crunchy pixels or a smooth HD image during races! Simply press TAB on a keyboard or SELECT on a game-pad to toggle between the two options. 

Here's a summary of everything included in this update:
[list]
[*]Incredible Icecap event removed.
[*]Cloudy Cruise event added.
[*]New HD resolution option.
[*]Minor tweak to Groovy Grasslands.
[*]Fixed missing collision in Bouncy Bay Multiplayer.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 2.1.3
notes.content: Fixed issue in stage 2-4 & 2-5 in story mode where players were unable to move.

notes.title: Multiplayer Update
notes.content:
The Multiplayer in World Racing '95 is getting a huge update! 
[list]
[*]Multiplayer now allows for both players to use game pads.
[*]All Arcade tracks are now playable in multiplayer (Including event tracks).
[*]The improved collision system has been implemented into multiplayer.
[/list]
This update also includes a few small improvements to the rest of the game
[list]
[*]All Arcade tracks are now playable in Survival (Including event tracks).
[*]Fixed controls display on Main Menu.
[*]Info on how to unlock the limited time seasonal tracks have been added to the track selection menu.
[/list]
Implementing these changes meant overhauling how the game handles player inputs, and although we haven't encountered any issues during testing, if you run into problems with specific controller or keyboard and mouse set-ups please let us know.  

A friendly reminder that the Incredible Icecap event has entered its final week so grab this new course while you can! We are hard at work on the next event so stay tuned for another announcement soon.

And as always... Happy Racing!.

notes.title: Wave 2 Launch
notes.content:
Welcome to the launch of what we're dubbing "Wave 2" of World Racing '95. After a long break from the last major update (August 2021) we have a new plan for more free content coming in 2023.

Unlike previous updates, this new content will have to be unlocked by completing a specific objective which can only be achieved during the event. Lets take a look at the first update of this new wave:

[u][b]Incredible Icecap[/b][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40434030/e1840cd1fe45be4621aa9fd2df1bdd8e4a4b9b05.jpg[/img]
This wintry track can be unlocked by collecting 5 presents scattered around [i]Frosty Freeway[/i] and finishing the race before the time runs out. This track is only available for unlock until the [b]28th of February[/b], so don't let it slip away!

Alongside these limited time content expansions, there will continue to be game play improvements that are not time sensitive. [b]While we cannot promise anything at the moment[/b], we have plans and hope to add the following over the next year:
[list]
[*] More Tracks available in survival mode
[*] More Tracks available in Multiplayer
[*] Improved Multiplayer experience.
[*] More Missions for Story Mode
[*] New Graphical options.
[/list]
Again please be aware [b]these are not confirmations of upcoming content[/b] and plans can change at anytime.

We hope you enjoy this new content and we look forward to continue to make World Racing '95 as good as it can be.

notes.title: Save data patch
notes.content:
Fixed issue where players playing for the first time would have a (close to) 100% completed save file.

If you have been affected by this and would like to reset your save, go to 

C:\Users\USERNAME\AppData\LocalLow\Oli Taylor\World Racing '95 and delete "SaveData.dat" to reset all the records of the base game, and delete "NewSaveData.dat" to reset all save data relating to the new content added since launch.

This will not reset Steam Achievements, this will not remove the new added content. It will remove best times, stars, story progression etc. 

Sorry for any inconvenience.

notes.title: The August Update
notes.content:
[b]The August Update is here[/b], with not one, but TWO new tracks to race on in Arcade Mode:
[list]
[*] Crazy Canyon - Watch out for falling boulders as you navigate a misty canyon.
[*] Hanging Heavens - Race across a garden levitating above the clouds.
[/list]
These will be available regardless of progress in the game for a month. After this they will require unlocking by completing different portions of the game. 

This update also includes a[b] new collision system[/b]. Now you will only spin out when hitting another car from behind. If you find any issues with this new system, please let us know. 

We have also added 10 brand new achievements for you to work towards, both for the base game and the new content.

We hope you continue to enjoy World Racing '95.

notes.title: Update and Plans for August
notes.content:
First of all I would personally like to say thank you for your support of World Racing '95, and I apologize for the lack of updates over the past month, as I have been busy with moving and finishing university.

It is now my top priority to make this game as good as it can be. so here is a list of everything you can expect before the end of August (Hopefully):

[list]
[*] A new collision detection system which makes racing more fluid, fast paced and less frustrating
[*] A new unlock-able Arcade mode track. 
[*] Displaying the control scheme on the main menu (Added today)
[*] Fixing an issue where steam can't find the .exe file (Fixed today)
[*] Fixing audio issues and adding some more music tracks
[/list]

Again thank you for your continuous support, and if you have any more recommendations please let us know either here or over on Instagram @oli_taylor_games 

Happy Racing!
